name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Collapsible sections with a smooth height animation. Single or multiple open.

name: activity-feed
title: Activity feed
description: Who did what and when, grouped under Today and Yesterday, with live relative times and an optional quoted detail.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
description: Confirm before something destructive. Cancel and confirm, controlled by you.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: Inline message in info, success, warning and danger.

name: analog-clock
title: Analog clock
description: SVG clock for any time zone, with a second hand that ticks with a small bounce.

name: app-shell
title: App shell
description: Sidebar, topbar and scrolling content area, plus a page header.

name: approval-flow
title: Approval flow
description: Chain of approvers with decisions, comments and times. The current approver gets Approve and Reject buttons.

name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: Smooth gradient areas, stacked or overlapping, that wipe in on scroll. Hover for a readout across series.

name: audit-log
title: Audit log
description: Who changed what and when, with expandable before and after values.

name: avatar-upload
title: Avatar upload
description: Click-to-change profile picture with instant preview, size and type checks, and a Remove link.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Image with initials fallback in a stable color. Five sizes, circle or square, presence dot (online, away, busy, offline), a stacked group with hover names, and UserInfo for avatar plus name and subtitle.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Status pill with semantic colors and an optional dot.

name: banner
title: Banner
description: Announcement bar that collapses smoothly when dismissed.

name: bar-list
title: Bar list
description: Ranked list with a bar behind each row: top pages, products, sources, countries.

name: border-beam
title: Border beam
description: A light beam that circles the border. For pricing cards and featured content.

name: bottom-nav
title: Bottom navigation
description: Mobile tab bar with icons, labels, an active pill and count badges.

name: bottom-sheet
title: Bottom sheet
description: Sheet that rises from the bottom, with a drag handle to dismiss. Radix Dialog underneath.

name: box-plot-chart
title: Box plot chart
description: Spread per group: box for the middle half, median line, whiskers and outlier dots. Boxes open from the median; hover for the five numbers.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Trail of parent pages.

name: bullet-chart
title: Bullet chart
description: A KPI against its target in one thin row, with shaded bands for poor, ok and good. The bar slides in on scroll.

name: bump-chart
title: Bump chart
description: Rank over time as smooth lines that swap places. Lines draw in one by one; hover a line or name to follow it.

name: butterfly-chart
title: Butterfly chart
description: Two bar sets back to back around shared rows, like a population pyramid. Bars grow outward from the middle.

name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Buttons joined into one row or column with shared borders and rounded outer corners.

name: button
title: Button
description: Thirteen variants from plain to glow, shine and 3D press, pill shape, five sizes, loading state, and asChild for links.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Month grid for one day or a range. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work.

name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick chart
description: Open, high, low and close per period. Green closed up, red closed down. Candles grow from their midpoint in sequence; hover for the four numbers.

name: card
title: Card
description: Bordered surface with header, content and footer parts.

name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Scroll-snap slides with arrows and animated dots.

name: changelog
title: Changelog
description: Release notes: version and date on the left, tagged New, Improved, Fixed or Removed changes on the right.

name: charts
title: Charts
description: Sparkline, bar chart and donut in plain SVG. No chart library.

name: chat
title: Chat
description: Message bubbles with avatars, timestamps, a typing indicator and a composer. Enter sends.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows.

name: chip
title: Chip
description: Toggleable filter chips, single or multi select.

name: chord-chart
title: Chord chart
description: Flow between every pair of items around a circle. Arcs sweep in, then ribbons fade in; hover an item to keep only its ribbons.

name: circle-pack-chart
title: Circle pack chart
description: One bubble per item, area by value, packed into a cluster. Bubbles pop out from the center biggest first; hover for the share.

name: code-block
title: Code block
description: Code with a title, optional line numbers and a copy button. No highlighter dependency.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: One section that opens with a smooth height animation.

name: color-picker
title: Color picker
description: Swatches, hex field and the native picker. Always returns a six-digit hex.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option.

name: command
title: Command palette
description: Searchable palette on cmdk. Bind it to Ctrl or Cmd K.

name: comment-thread
title: Comment thread
description: Nested comments with inline reply boxes, three levels deep.

name: compare
title: Image compare
description: Before and after slider. Drag or use arrow keys.

name: comparison-table
title: Comparison table
description: Plans across the top, features down the side, a check, dash or text in each cell. For pricing pages.

name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Burst of confetti from any button, or call fireConfetti(x, y) yourself.

name: context-menu
title: Context menu
description: Right-click menu with items, shortcuts, checkbox items, labels and nested submenus.

name: cookie-consent
title: Cookie consent
description: Bottom-left consent card that remembers Accept or Decline.

name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: Copies text and morphs to a check.

name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: Live countdown with flipping digits.

name: coupon-input
title: Coupon input
description: Promo code field with async validation, an error message and a removable applied chip.

name: credit-card
title: Credit card
description: Payment card preview that flips in 3D to show the CVV. Formats as the user types, guesses Visa, Mastercard, AmEx or RuPay, and can mask the number.

name: currency-input
title: Currency input
description: Money field that groups digits as you type (1,25,000) and hands you a plain number.

name: data-table
title: Data table
description: Sortable columns, a search box and pagination, with optional row selection and bulk actions, column visibility menu, sticky header, toolbar slot, row action menus and clickable rows. You pass rows and column definitions.

name: date-picker
title: Date picker
description: Date and date range fields that open a calendar. The range picker has optional quick presets (Last 7 days, This month...) and a day count. Closes on pick.

name: datetime-picker
title: Date and time picker
description: One field for a day and a time: calendar on top, time picker below.

name: day-agenda
title: Day agenda
description: One day as a time grid: events sit at their time, overlapping ones share the width, a red now-line marks the time.

name: description-list
title: Description list
description: Label and value pairs for a details panel, in one to three columns, optionally with dividers.

name: dialog
title: Dialog and Sheet
description: Centered modal and edge-docked sheet on Radix Dialog.

name: diff-viewer
title: Diff viewer
description: Before and after text as a unified diff: red removed lines, green added lines, line numbers, and unchanged stretches folded.

name: dock
title: Dock
description: Icons that grow toward the pointer, like the macOS dock.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
description: Action menu with checkbox items, shortcuts and destructive items.

name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: Drag and drop file area with size check and removable file list.

name: dumbbell-chart
title: Dumbbell chart
description: Change per item as two dots joined by a line: before and after, plan and actual. Green when good, red when bad.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Dashed placeholder with icon, text and an action.

name: error-state
title: Error state
description: Full-section error or not found screen with a code or icon, explanation and retry actions.

name: event-calendar
title: Event calendar
description: Month view with events on their days, multi-day spans, +n more overflow, locale-aware names and RTL arrows.

name: fab
title: Floating action button
description: Round primary action, extended with a label, or a speed dial that fans out actions.

name: file-manager
title: File manager
description: Folder browser with breadcrumb, list and grid views, selection and double-click or Enter to open.

name: file-uploader
title: File uploader
description: Multi-file drop area with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and a concurrency limit. You supply the upload function.

name: filter-bar
title: Filter bar
description: Removable filter chips with an Add filter menu: pick a field, then a value.

name: forecast-chart
title: Forecast chart
description: Solid line for what happened, dashed line inside a shaded band for what is expected. The band is the likely range.

name: format
title: Format helpers
description: formatCurrency, formatCompact, formatPercent, formatBytes, formatDuration and a signed Currency component. Indian rupees by default.

name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: Conversion funnel with a bar per stage and the step-to-step rate.

name: gantt
title: Gantt chart
description: Schedule view with a bar per task, progress fill, weekend shading and a today line.

name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: Half-circle meter with a needle that swings to the value.

name: half-donut-chart
title: Half donut chart
description: A semicircle split into parts with a total under the arch. Half the height of a donut, so it fits dashboard cards.

name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: Contribution-style grid for daily activity. Cells pop in column by column.

name: histogram-chart
title: Histogram chart
description: Counts how many values fall in each range from raw data, with a smooth curve over the bars. Bars rise in turn.

name: image-upload
title: Image upload
description: Thumbnail grid with remove buttons, a cover label and a drop tile. Limits count, type and size.

name: image-viewer
title: Image viewer
description: Lightbox with arrows, click to zoom and keyboard control.

name: inline-edit
title: Inline edit
description: Text that becomes a field on click. Enter saves, Escape cancels.

name: input-group
title: Input group
description: One field with text, icons or buttons attached at the start or end, like https:// or .com.

name: input
title: Input
description: Text input and textarea with icon, trailing slot, and invalid state.

name: invoice
title: Invoice
description: Printable invoice with number, status, from and bill-to, line items, tax and total computed from the lines.

name: kanban
title: Kanban board
description: Columns of draggable cards. Drag with the mouse or move a focused card with Alt and the arrow keys. Controlled, no drag library.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Keyboard key hint.

name: label
title: Label and Field
description: Label with required marker, plus Field for label, control and hint or error.

name: landing-sections
title: Landing sections
description: Marketing page parts: Hero, LogoStrip, FeatureGrid, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner and SiteFooter. Stack them with a Navbar.

name: leaderboard
title: Leaderboard
description: Ranked people or teams with avatars, score bars, gold, silver and bronze badges and place changes. Sorted for you; bars fill in on scroll.

name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: Multi-series line or area chart in plain SVG with grid, axis labels, legend and a hover readout.

name: live-chart
title: Live chart
description: Streaming line chart that slides left as new values arrive. You give it a function for the next value; pause it any time.

name: loader
title: Loader
description: Six loading animations (ring, dots, bars, pulse, orbit, dual), an indeterminate or determinate bar loader, and a loading overlay.

name: lollipop-chart
title: Lollipop chart
description: A bar chart as a thin stick with a dot on the end, sorted largest first. Lighter than bars when there are many items.

name: marimekko-chart
title: Marimekko chart
description: Stacked 100% bars whose widths also mean something: column width is group size, block height is mix. Columns grow up on scroll.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Endless logo or tag scroll with edge fade. Pauses on hover.

name: matrix-heatmap
title: Matrix heatmap
description: Rows by columns shaded by value: traffic by hour and weekday, cohort retention. Cells fade in as a wave; hover lights up the row and column.

name: mention-input
title: Mention input
description: Textarea that suggests people when you type @. Arrow keys and Enter pick.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Top bar with brand, links and actions that folds into a menu on small screens.

name: notification-center
title: Notification center
description: Bell with an unread count and a popover list. Click marks read, Mark all read clears it.

name: notification-preferences
title: Notification preferences
description: Grid of events by channel (email, push, SMS, in-app) with a switch per cell and a switch per channel.

name: number-stepper
title: Number stepper
description: Number field with plus and minus buttons and arrow keys.

name: number-ticker
title: Number ticker
description: Counts up to a value with easing once it scrolls into view.

name: onboarding-carousel
title: Onboarding carousel
description: Mobile first-run intro with swipeable slides, dots, Skip and a final Get started button.

name: onboarding-checklist
title: Onboarding checklist
description: Getting-started card with a progress bar, tick-off items, short help text and actions. Collapsible.

name: order-summary
title: Order summary
description: Cart lines with subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total computed for you. Slots for a coupon field and a checkout button.

name: order-tracker
title: Order tracker
description: Delivery progress as steps joined by a line that fills up to the current one. Horizontal on wide screens, vertical on phones.

name: org-chart
title: Org chart
description: Reporting tree with connector lines and collapsible teams.

name: otp-input
title: OTP input
description: Code boxes with paste, backspace, arrow keys, autofill and a shake on error.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page buttons with ellipsis for long ranges.

name: pareto-chart
title: Pareto chart
description: Causes sorted by size as bars plus a running-total line with an 80% mark. Shows which few causes matter most.

name: password-input
title: Password input
description: Show and hide toggle with an optional strength meter.

name: permission-matrix
title: Permission matrix
description: Roles by permissions grid of checkboxes with per-column toggle and locked roles.

name: phone-input
title: Phone input
description: Phone field with a country picker. Groups digits as you type and hands back the E.164 number and whether it is complete.

name: pie-chart
title: Pie chart
description: Slices of one whole that sweep around on scroll. Hover a slice or legend row and it pulls out.

name: pivot-table
title: Pivot table
description: Cross-tab of your rows: one field down the side, another across the top, sum, count, average, min or max in each cell, with totals and heat shading.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

name: pricing-card
title: Pricing card
description: Plan card whose price counts to the new value. The highlighted plan gets a travelling border beam.

name: product-card
title: Product card
description: Product tile with image, rating, price with strike-through, discount tag, wishlist heart and Add button. Also exports Price.

name: profile-card
title: Profile card
description: Person card with banner, avatar, role, stats and an actions slot.

name: progress-ring
title: Progress ring
description: Circular progress with an eased stroke animation.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: Thin progress bar with four tones.

name: pull-to-refresh
title: Pull to refresh
description: Scroll area you pull down from the top to refresh, with a spinner until your promise settles.

name: punch-card-chart
title: Punch card chart
description: A grid of dots where dot size is the value, like commits by weekday and hour. Dots pop in on a diagonal wave.

name: radar-chart
title: Radar chart
description: Spider chart for several scores on the same axes: a pentagon with five, a hexagon with six. Shapes grow from the center on scroll; hover a legend name to highlight a series.

name: radial-bar-chart
title: Radial bar chart
description: Concentric rings, one per goal, that sweep in on scroll. Legend hover highlights a ring; the middle takes any content.

name: radial-line-chart
title: Radial line chart
description: A line chart bent into a circle for things that repeat: 24 hours, 12 months. A smooth closed shape grows from the middle.

name: radio-group
title: Radio group
description: Native radios as selectable cards with descriptions.

name: rating-breakdown
title: Rating breakdown
description: Review summary: big average, stars and a bar per star level. Rows can act as filters. Bars fill in on scroll.

name: rating
title: Rating
description: Star rating with hover preview. Read-only when no handler is given.

name: relative-time
title: Relative time
description: "3 minutes ago", kept live. Hover for the full date. Uses Intl, so it speaks your locale.

name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Scroll-in fade-up wrapper and a blur-in headline. One IntersectionObserver each.

name: rich-text-editor
title: Rich text editor
description: Small editor with bold, italic, underline, heading, lists, quote and link. Value is HTML. Built on contentEditable, no dependency.

name: ridgeline-chart
title: Ridgeline chart
description: One smooth curve per row, overlapping like mountain ridges on a shared scale. Ridges rise in turn; hover one to bring it forward.

name: rose-chart
title: Rose chart
description: Polar area chart: equal-angle petals whose length is the value. Petals bloom from the center in turn; hover one to read it.

name: sankey-chart
title: Sankey chart
description: Flow diagram where ribbon width is the amount: traffic to page to outcome, budget to team. Ribbons draw in; hover follows a flow.

name: saved-views
title: Saved views
description: Menu of saved table setups: pick one, save the current one under a name, delete.

name: scatter-chart
title: Scatter chart
description: Scatter and bubble chart with axis labels, groups by color and a nearest-point hover. Points pop in one by one on scroll.

name: schema-form
title: Schema form
description: Build a form from a description: text, email, number, date, select, textarea and checkbox fields, validation, and optional multi-step wizard with a stepper.

name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll progress
description: Thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or a container.

name: search-bar
title: Search bar
description: Search field with live results, highlighted matches, recent searches and full keyboard control.

name: search-input
title: Search input
description: Search field with a clear button, Escape to clear and a slash shortcut to focus.

name: segmented
title: Segmented control
description: Pick one of a few views or ranges. Smaller than tabs.

name: select
title: Select
description: Styled dropdown with groups, built on Radix Select.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

name: settings-layout
title: Settings layout
description: Settings page frame: vertical section list on the left, SettingsSection rows (title and help on the left, controls on the right).

name: shimmer-text
title: Shimmer text
description: Text with a light sweep passing over it.

name: shortcuts-dialog
title: Shortcuts dialog
description: Keyboard cheat sheet that opens on ? and shows grouped shortcuts as keycaps.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Collapsible nav with groups, nested links and badges. Icon rail on desktop, slide-over on mobile.

name: signature-pad
title: Signature pad
description: Draw-your-signature canvas for mouse, touch and pen. Sharp on retina screens, exports a PNG.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Shimmering placeholder for content that is loading.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Native range input with a filled track and floating value bubble.

name: slope-chart
title: Slope chart
description: One line per item between two moments. Steep means big change, crossing means swapped places. Green rose, red fell.

name: sortable-list
title: Sortable list
description: Reorder rows by dragging, or with arrow keys on the grip. Controlled, no drag library.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Tiny CSS spinner that inherits text color.

name: split-pane
title: Split pane
description: Two resizable panels with a draggable divider. Keyboard resizable. Horizontal or vertical.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight card
description: Card with a glow and border highlight that follow the cursor.

name: stacked-bar-chart
title: Stacked bar chart
description: Bars split into colored segments that grow in on scroll, with a hover breakdown and legend. Sessions by device, revenue by plan.

name: stat-card
title: Stat card
description: KPI tile with value, trend delta and a sparkline slot.

name: status-dot
title: Status dot
description: Small status light with an optional pulse and label.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Horizontal steps for multi-step forms and onboarding.

name: stopwatch
title: Stopwatch
description: Start, pause, lap and reset, down to hundredths of a second.

name: stream-chart
title: Stream chart
description: Streamgraph: smooth stacked flows around a center line to show shifts in mix over time. Ripples in from the left; hover a flow to focus it.

name: sunburst-chart
title: Sunburst chart
description: A hierarchy as concentric rings: each ring splits its parent. Rings sweep outward; hover a slice to light up its parents and children.

name: swipe-actions
title: Swipe actions
description: List row you swipe left to reveal action buttons. Touch, mouse drag and keyboard.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately.

name: table-of-contents
title: Table of contents
description: On this page list that highlights the section currently in view.

name: table
title: Table
description: Dense table parts with hover rows, a selected state, footer and caption.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Underline or pill tabs on Radix Tabs.

name: tag-input
title: Tag input
description: Type and press Enter to add chips. Backspace removes the last.

name: tag-manager
title: Tag manager
description: Create, rename, recolor and delete labels, with usage counts.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: Dark terminal window with prompt lines and output. Optional typing animation.

name: testimonial-card
title: Testimonial card
description: Customer quote with avatar, role and optional star rating.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme toggle
description: Icon button that flips light and dark mode and remembers the choice. Also exports a useTheme hook.

name: tilt-card
title: Tilt card
description: 3D card that tilts toward the cursor with a moving sheen.

name: time-picker
title: Time picker
description: Hour, minute and AM/PM segments you type into or step with arrow keys. 12 or 24 hour.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Vertical activity feed with tone-colored markers.

name: timer
title: Timer
description: Countdown with a ring that drains smoothly, presets and an onDone callback.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Call toast.success() from anywhere. No provider needed.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: Two-state button for favourite, bold or mute. Announces its state to screen readers.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Hint on hover and focus. Optional title, keyboard shortcut, light style and arrow, plus an (i) InfoTip and a TruncatedText that only shows a tooltip when cut off.

name: tree-table
title: Tree table
description: Table whose rows have child rows. Expand and collapse branches by click or arrow keys.

name: tree-view
title: Tree view
description: Nested expandable list with animated open and close.

name: treemap
title: Treemap
description: Tiles sized by value, packed to stay square. Budget by team, revenue by product. Spring in on scroll; hover lifts one tile and dims the rest.

name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
description: Types, holds and deletes phrases in a loop. Static for reduced motion.

name: uptime-bar
title: Uptime bar
description: Status-page strip with one tick per day in green, amber or red, the uptime percentage and an incident note on hover.

name: user-menu
title: User menu
description: Avatar button for the topbar that opens a menu with name, email, your links and Sign out.

name: venn-chart
title: Venn chart
description: Two or three overlapping circles with a count in every region: who is in one group, who is in several.

name: version-log
title: Version log
description: Animated version history: the rail draws and dots pop as releases scroll in, entries slide in one by one, releases fold open, with a version jump strip and a kind filter.

name: virtual-list
title: Virtual list
description: Windowed list that renders only the visible rows. 100,000 items stay smooth.

name: waffle-chart
title: Waffle chart
description: A grid of 100 squares, each one percent of the whole. Squares pop in as a wave; hover a legend row to light up its squares.

name: waterfall-chart
title: Waterfall chart
description: How a start number becomes an end number: green adds, red subtracts, blue totals. Bars drop in one after another with connector lines.

name: week-strip
title: Week strip
description: Seven day pills with previous and next week arrows, a selected day and dots under days that have something. Arrow keys move the day.

name: word-cloud
title: Word cloud
description: Words sized by how often they appear, biggest in the middle. Words grow in; hover to focus one, or make them clickable filters.

name: world-clock
title: World clock
description: Cities with live local time, a day or night icon and the hour difference from you.

name: block:admin-shell
title: Admin shell
description: Full app frame: grouped sidebar with nested links, topbar with search, alerts and user menu, and a dashboard page.

name: block:analytics-dashboard
title: Analytics dashboard
description: Visitors, page views, session time and conversion KPIs, a traffic area chart, device donut, top pages bar list and weekday bars.

name: block:api-keys-page
title: API keys page
description: Create, reveal, copy and revoke keys, with a masked secret and an empty state.

name: block:billing-page
title: Billing page
description: Current plan with seat and storage usage bars, payment method card and an invoice history table.

name: block:campaign-performance
title: Campaign performance
description: Channel KPIs, weekly leads chart and a campaign budget table.

name: block:checkout-page
title: Checkout page
description: Delivery address form with validation, shipping options, coupon code and a live order summary.

name: block:ecommerce-dashboard
title: Ecommerce dashboard
description: Sales, orders, customers and to-ship KPIs, revenue chart, top products and a recent orders table with status badges.

name: block:employee-directory
title: Employee directory
description: Searchable table with status filter, row selection, actions and pagination.

name: block:hrms-overview
title: People overview
description: Headcount, attendance, department split and activity feed.

name: block:inbox
title: Inbox
description: Two-pane mail view: searchable list with unread dots, message reader with reply, archive and delete. Single pane on mobile.

name: block:invoice-page
title: Invoice page
description: A full invoice with print, download and send actions.

name: block:landing-page
title: Landing page
description: Whole marketing page: navbar, hero, logos, feature grid, stats, FAQ, call to action and footer.

name: block:lead-pipeline
title: Lead pipeline
description: Drag-and-drop board with column totals and a keyboard-friendly move button.

name: block:leave-approvals
title: Leave approvals
description: Manager inbox with tabs, balance bars and approve or reject toasts.

name: block:leave-request-form
title: Leave request form
description: Date range, approver combobox, multi-select notify list, working-day count and field validation.

name: block:not-found-page
title: Not found page
description: Full-page 404 with search and two ways out. Reuse for 403 and 500.

name: block:pricing-page
title: Pricing page
description: Headline, monthly or yearly switch, three plan cards with a highlighted one, and an FAQ.

name: block:profile-page
title: Profile page
description: Cover and avatar header with actions, then About (details list) and Activity (timeline) tabs.

name: block:project-overview
title: Project overview
description: Project header with status and team, progress ring with phase bars, task list and a milestone timeline.

name: block:reports-table
title: Reports table
description: Searchable, filterable, sortable reports table with row action menus and a details drawer.

name: block:reset-password
title: Reset password
description: Four steps: ask for email, check your inbox with a resend timer, choose a new password, done.

name: block:sales-dashboard
title: Sales dashboard
description: KPI cards, revenue line chart against target, pipeline funnel and a top deals table.

name: block:settings-page
